Name: MENU_COMMON_PARAM_ST
Description: Global menu and HUD settings: death screen timing, HP/FP/stamina bar lengths, key guide icons, world map cursor and travel limits, compass ranges, system announcements and auto-hide HUD thresholds. Only row 0 is used.

Fields.Name: YOU DIED - Fade Out Delay (Host)
Fields.Description: Seconds after YOU DIED appears before the screen fades out when you die as the host or in solo play.

Fields.Name: YOU DIED - Fade Out Delay (Phantom)
Fields.Description: Seconds after the death message appears before the screen fades out when you die as a summoned or invading phantom. One of the death sequences waits twice this value plus 1.5 seconds instead.

Fields.Name: HP Bar - Full-Length Max HP
Fields.Description: Max HP at which the HP bar reaches its full length. A lower max HP gives a proportionally shorter bar; higher values are capped at full length.

Fields.Name: FP Bar - Full-Length Max FP
Fields.Description: Max FP at which the FP bar reaches its full length. A lower max FP gives a proportionally shorter bar; higher values are capped at full length.

Fields.Name: Stamina Bar - Full-Length Max Stamina
Fields.Description: Max stamina at which the stamina bar reaches its full length. A lower max stamina gives a proportionally shorter bar; higher values are capped at full length.

Fields.Name: Action Panel - Max Switch Speed
Fields.Description: Metres per second. The action panel can only be switched while the player moves at or below this speed.

Fields.Name: Action Panel - Speed Averaging Time
Fields.Description: Seconds over which the player's speed is averaged for Action Panel - Max Switch Speed. 0 uses the current speed.

Fields.Name: Key Guide Icon - Vertical Offset
Fields.Description: Vertical offset in pixels of button icons inside on-screen text (key guides). Positive moves the icon up, negative down.

Fields.Name: World Map - Cursor Select Radius
Fields.Description: Pixels. A map icon within this radius of the cursor is selected.

Fields.Name: HUD Update Highlight Time
Fields.Description: Seconds a HUD entry stays highlighted after its value changes. Read as a float, not an integer. Retail: 1.

Fields.Name: Decal Position Offset X
Fields.Description: Decal display position offset left and right

Fields.Name: Decal Position Offset Y
Fields.Description: Decal display position offset vertical direction

Fields.Name: Target State Icon - Search Duration
Fields.Description: The number of seconds it takes for the FE Search icon to start fading in and then fading out.

Fields.Name: Target State Icon - Battle Duration
Fields.Description: The number of seconds it takes for the FE Battle icon to start fading in and then fading out.

Fields.Name: World Map - Cursor Speed
Fields.Description: Cursor speed in pixels per second at full stick tilt, scaled by the stick input and the current zoom level.

Fields.Name: World Map - Cursor First Step Distance
Fields.Description: Distance to move only once at the first input [px]

Fields.Name: World Map - Cursor First Step Delay
Fields.Description: The time it takes to move only once at the first input [sec]

Fields.Name: World Map - Cursor Wait Time
Fields.Description: Waiting time from input to smooth movement [sec]

Fields.Name: World Map - Cursor Snap Radius
Fields.Description: Pixels. The cursor snaps to a map icon that comes within this radius.

Fields.Name: World Map - Cursor Snap Time
Fields.Description: Seconds the cursor takes to move onto the icon it snaps to.

Fields.Name: Item Pickup Log - Display Time
Fields.Description: Time to add one line of log and fade out. There is a timer for each line [sec]

Fields.Name: Poise Bar - Full-Length Max Poise
Fields.Description: It is used to calculate what percentage of the gauge length provided by the resource is used when displaying the SA gauge.

Fields.Name: World Map - Underground Layer Event Flag
Fields.Description: Event flag that must be ON for the underground map to be available on the world map. -1 uses flag 0.

Fields.Name: World Map - Travelled Area Margin
Fields.Description: Metres. Each map layer keeps a travelled rectangle that grows to include the player's position plus this margin in all four directions; it sets how far the world map can be scrolled.

Fields.Name: System Announcement - Scroll Pause Time
Fields.Description: Seconds a long system announcement waits before and after each scroll pass.

Fields.Name: System Announcement - Scroll Speed
Fields.Description: Scroll speed of long system announcements in pixels per second (1920 × 1080 menu space).

Fields.Name: System Announcement - Short Text Display Time
Fields.Description: Seconds a short system announcement that doesn't need scrolling stays on screen.

Fields.Name: System Announcement - Scroll Repeat Count
Fields.Description: Number of times a long system announcement scrolls before it fades out.

Fields.Name: Credits Colour: Red
Fields.Description: Red component (0-255) of the colour used by the credits (staff roll) screen for most endings. Retail: 230.

Fields.Name: Credits Colour: Green
Fields.Description: Green component (0-255) of the credits screen colour. Retail: 230.

Fields.Name: Credits Colour: Blue
Fields.Description: Blue component (0-255) of the credits screen colour. Retail: 230.

Fields.Name: Compass Memo Display Distance
Fields.Description: Display distance [m] of the memo marker displayed on the compass. Anything closer than this distance will be displayed

Fields.Name: Compass Bonfire Display Distance
Fields.Description: The display distance of the bonfire displayed on the compass [m]. Anything closer than this distance will be displayed

Fields.Name: World Map - Starting Zoom
Fields.Description: Zoom level the world map opens at, between World Map Zoom Min and World Map Zoom Max.

Fields.Name: Colour Picker - Saturation/Brightness Slider Speed
Fields.Description: Percent per second the saturation and brightness sliders of the colour picker move at full stick tilt (scaled by stick input).

Fields.Name: Opening Movie - Wait Time
Fields.Description: Seconds to wait before the opening movie plays.

Fields.Name: Key Guide Icon - Scale
Fields.Description: Percent of the texture size at which button icons inside on-screen text (key guides) are drawn. 100 is the texture size.

Fields.Name: Key Guide Icon - Scale (Controls List)
Fields.Description: Percent of the texture size at which button icons are drawn in the controls list. 100 is the texture size.

Fields.Name: Key Guide Icon - Vertical Offset (Controls List)
Fields.Description: Vertical offset in pixels of button icons in the controls list. Positive moves the icon up, negative down.

Fields.Name: Key Guide Icon - Scale (Key Config)
Fields.Description: Percent of the texture size at which button icons are drawn in the key config menu. 100 is the texture size.

Fields.Name: Key Guide Icon - Vertical Offset (Key Config)
Fields.Description: Vertical offset in pixels of button icons in the key config menu. Positive moves the icon up, negative down.

Fields.Name: World Map - Reveal Radius
Fields.Description: Metres. Radius around the player that is marked as visited on the world map.

Fields.Name: Tutorial Popup - Display Time
Fields.Description: Tutorial (toast notification) display time [sec]. It will be closed automatically after this time has passed

Fields.Name: Compass - Friendly Host Hide Distance
Fields.Description: Metres (horizontal). A friendly host is not shown on the compass while closer than this. 0 always shows them.

Fields.Name: Compass Hostile Phantom Display Distance
Fields.Description: Display distance [m] of other players (enemy hosts) displayed on the compass. If you are more than this distance, it will be displayed on the compass.

Fields.Name: Compass - Friendly Guest Hide Distance
Fields.Description: Metres (horizontal). A friendly guest phantom is not shown on the compass while closer than this. 0 always shows them.

Fields.Name: Cutscene Skip Prompt - Display Time
Fields.Description: Seconds the skip prompt stays on screen after a button is pressed during a cutscene. The skip is only accepted while the prompt is shown.

Fields.Name: Auto HUD - Show HP Bar Below %
Fields.Description: With the HUD set to Auto, the HP bar stays visible while HP is at or below this percent of max HP. Combined with the value threshold by OR. -1 disables.

Fields.Name: Auto HUD - Show HP Bar Below Value
Fields.Description: With the HUD set to Auto, the HP bar stays visible while current HP is at or below this value. Combined with the percent threshold by OR. -1 disables.

Fields.Name: Auto HUD - Show FP Bar Below %
Fields.Description: With the HUD set to Auto, the FP bar stays visible while FP is at or below this percent of max FP. Combined with the value threshold by OR. -1 disables.

Fields.Name: Auto HUD - Show FP Bar Below Value
Fields.Description: With the HUD set to Auto, the FP bar stays visible while current FP is at or below this value. Combined with the percent threshold by OR. -1 disables.

Fields.Name: Auto HUD - Show Stamina Bar Below %
Fields.Description: With the HUD set to Auto, the stamina bar stays visible while stamina is at or below this percent of max stamina. Combined with the value threshold by OR. -1 disables.

Fields.Name: Auto HUD - Show Stamina Bar Below Value
Fields.Description: With the HUD set to Auto, the stamina bar stays visible while current stamina is at or below this value. Combined with the percent threshold by OR. -1 disables.

Fields.Name: World Map - Zoom Animation Time
Fields.Description: Seconds the world map zoom animation takes.

Fields.Name: World Map - Minimum Icon Scale
Fields.Description: Scale of world map icons when fully zoomed out (0–1). Icons grow towards 1 as you zoom in, following the square root of the zoom progress.

Fields.Name: World Map - Map Point Travelled Margin
Fields.Description: Metres. Margin added in all four directions when a map point (WorldMapPointParam) adds its position to the travelled rectangle, if the unlock doesn't give its own margin.

Fields.Name: Enemy HP Bar - Screen Left Limit
Fields.Description: Pixels (1920 × 1080 menu space). The centre of an enemy's floating HP bar is kept at or right of this X position.

Fields.Name: Enemy HP Bar - Screen Right Limit
Fields.Description: Pixels (1920 × 1080 menu space). The centre of an enemy's floating HP bar is kept at or left of this X position.

Fields.Name: Enemy HP Bar - Screen Top Limit
Fields.Description: Pixels (1920 × 1080 menu space). The centre of an enemy's floating HP bar is kept at or below this Y position.

Fields.Name: Enemy HP Bar - Screen Bottom Limit
Fields.Description: Pixels (1920 × 1080 menu space). The centre of an enemy's floating HP bar is kept at or above this Y position.

Fields.Name: HP Threshold to display Horse HP
Fields.Description: Threshold for displaying the PC horse HP gauge at the time of recovery. Constant value of Display HP bar when it increases more than a certain value at a time

Fields.Name: World Map Zoom Min
Fields.Description: Lowest world map zoom scale; the zoom is kept between this and World Map Zoom Max. Retail: 0.48.

Fields.Name: World Map Zoom Max
Fields.Description: Highest world map zoom scale. Retail: 1.5.

Fields.Name: Scroll Bar Speed
Fields.Description: Speed of a scrollable menu panel when scrolled with the stick or keys, in percent of the full length per second (the mouse wheel moves it in larger steps). Retail: 120.
Appears unused by the game. Retail: 0.5.

Fields.Name: Map Marker Display Distance Max
Fields.Description: HUD world markers farther than this many metres are hidden. -1: no limit. Retail: -1.

Fields.Name: Map Marker Near Distance
Fields.Description: Distance in m below which a HUD world marker uses its near display state. Retail: 25.

Fields.Name: Map Marker Far Distance
Fields.Description: Distance in m at or beyond which a HUD world marker uses its far display state (between Near and Far: middle state). Retail: 50.

Fields.Name: Map Marker Distance Margin
Fields.Description: Extra distance in m a marker must cross before switching back between near, middle and far states, so it does not flicker at a boundary. Retail: 5.

Fields.Name: Terms of Service Scroll Acceleration Time
Fields.Description: Seconds of holding the scroll input in the Terms of Service text before scrolling reaches Max Speed (eased in, squared). Retail: 3.

Fields.Name: Terms of Service Scroll Min Speed
Fields.Description: Scroll speed of the Terms of Service text when the scroll input is first held. Retail: 30.

Fields.Name: Terms of Service Scroll Max Speed
Fields.Description: Scroll speed of the Terms of Service text after Acceleration Time of holding. Retail: 90.

Fields.Name: Terms of Service Scroll Value 3
Fields.Description: Read with the Terms of Service scroll speeds; its use is not established. Retail: 30.

Fields.Name: HUD Character Marker Distance
Fields.Description: Distance threshold for a HUD marker of a character: when the character is off screen and this far or more, the marker's edge state is cleared. Exact effect not established. Retail: 50.

Fields.Name: World Map Cursor Speed Min
Fields.Description: World map cursor speed at the lowest speed setting (0); scaled by the zoom. The speed rises linearly to World Map Cursor Speed Max at setting 10. Retail: 100.

Fields.Name: World Map Cursor Speed Max
Fields.Description: World map cursor speed at the highest speed setting (10). Retail: 820.
